label: simulated
description: Synthetic demo requests written for the BMW hackathon prototype. They are not BMW data, do not quote BMW records and name no real person; every request is labelled simulated. Loaded by POST /requests/fixtures/simulated.

requests.title: More rear legroom and long-wheelbase comfort
requests.body: Chauffeur-driven and family customers in China expect generous rear legroom. Our sales teams report that buyers compare rear knee room with long-wheelbase competitors. Please consider a long-wheelbase derivative with more rear space and comfortable rear seats.

requests.origin_name: BMW of North America product planning (simulated)
requests.title: Louder, sportier exhaust note
requests.body: US customers expect the engine sound to match the sporty driving experience. Dealers hear that the exhaust note is too subdued compared with competitors. Please make a louder, sportier exhaust sound available.

requests.title: Ventilated rear seats
requests.body: In hot climates rear passengers ask for ventilated rear seats. Customers want cooled rear seats for summer comfort, like the front seats already offer.

requests.title: Physical climate control buttons
requests.body: Customers find it difficult to adjust the climate control through the touchscreen menu while driving. Please bring back physical buttons for temperature and fan speed.

requests.title: Is a fast-charging time target customer-relevant?
requests.body: Engineering asks whether a target for DC fast-charging time (10-80%) is relevant to customers of the successor, or whether customers care more about charging reliability. Please confirm whether charging time should become a customer requirement.

requests.title: Lower price for the Comfort package
requests.body: Customers say the Comfort package costs too much. Please reduce the package price and offer a leasing discount for the successor.
